title: Use of Deep-Learning Assisted Assessment of Cardiac Parameters in Zebrafish to Discover Cyanidin Chloride as a Novel Keap1 Inhibitor Against Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity.
authors: Liu, Changtong; Wang, Yingchao; Zeng, Yixin; Kang, Zirong; Zhao, Hong; Qi, Kun; Wu, Hongzhi; Zhao, Lu; Wang, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习辅助斑马鱼心脏表型筛选发现Keap1抑制剂，涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy (DIC) brings tough clinical challenges as well as continued demand in developing agents for adjuvant cardioprotective therapies. Here, a zebrafish phenotypic screening with deep-learning assisted multiplex cardiac functional analysis using motion videos of larval hearts is established. Through training the model on a dataset of 2125 labeled ventricular images, ZVSegNet and HRNet exhibit superior performance over previous methods. As a result of high-content phenotypic screening, cyanidin chloride (CyCl) is identified as a potent suppressor of DIC. CyCl effectively rescues cardiac cell death and improves heart function in both in vitro and in vivo models of Doxorubicin (Dox) exposure. CyCl shows strong inhibitory effects on lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial damage and prevents ferroptosis and apoptosis-related cell death. Molecular docking and thermal shift assay further suggest a direct binding between CyCl and Keap1, which may compete for the Keap1-Nrf2 interaction, promote nuclear accumulation of Nrf2, and subsequentially transactivate Gpx4 and other antioxidant factors. Site-specific mutation of R415A in Keap1 significantly attenuates the protective effects of CyCl against Dox-induced cardiotoxicity. Taken together, the capability of deep-learning-assisted phenotypic screening in identifying promising lead compounds against DIC is exhibited, and new perspectives into drug discovery in the era of artificial intelligence are provided.
abstract_zh: 阿霉素诱导的心肌病（DIC）带来了严峻的临床挑战，同时也持续需求开发用于辅助心脏保护治疗的药物。在此，建立了一种基于斑马鱼表型筛选的方法，利用幼虫心脏的运动视频，结合深度学习辅助的多重心脏功能分析。通过在包含2125张标记心室图像的数据集上训练模型，ZVSegNet和HRNet表现出优于以往方法的性能。通过高内涵表型筛选，氯化花青素（CyCl）被鉴定为DIC的有效抑制剂。CyCl在体外和体内阿霉素（Dox）暴露模型中均能有效挽救心脏细胞死亡并改善心脏功能。CyCl对脂质过氧化和线粒体损伤表现出强抑制作用，并防止铁死亡和凋亡相关的细胞死亡。分子对接和热位移实验进一步表明，CyCl与Keap1之间存在直接结合，这可能竞争Keap1-Nrf2相互作用，促进Nrf2的核积累，并随后反式激活Gpx4及其他抗氧化因子。Keap1中R415A的位点特异性突变显著减弱了CyCl对Dox诱导的心脏毒性的保护作用。综上所述，本研究展示了深度学习辅助的表型筛选在识别针对DIC的有前景先导化合物方面的能力，并为人工智能时代的药物发现提供了新视角。
